sagreement%2C%20and%20movement%20into%20or%20out%20of%20the%20highest%0A%20%20%20%20quartile.%20These%20are%20direct%20cross-frame%20comparisons.%20They%20are%20not%20estimates%20of%20information%20lost%0A%20%20%20%20by%20mathematically%20aggregating%20tract%20numerators%20and%20denominators.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20A%20parallel%20Census%20ZIP%20Code%20Tabulation%20Area%20(ZCTA)%20analysis%20tests%20whether%20results%20depend%20on%20the%0A%20%20%20%20selected%20coarse%20geography.%20CDC%20PLACES%20comparisons%20provide%20secondary%20cross-source%20context.%0A%20%20%20%20Community-area%20life-expectancy%20models%20and%20spatial%20analyses%20are%20supplementary%20demonstrations.%0A%20%20%20%20CHM%20measures%20refer%20to%20observed%20CAPriCORN%20adults%2C%20not%20all%20Chicago%20residents.%20No%20source%20is%20a%20truth%0A%20%20%20%20standard%2C%20and%20no%20analysis%20estimates%20a%20causal%20effect.%20Aggregate%20results%20are%20visible%20for%20the%0A%20%20%20%20independent%20statistician%20while%20manuscript%20authorization%20remains%20closed.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Statistician%20Review%20Guide%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20notebook%20is%20both%20an%20executable%20statistical%20analysis%20plan%20and%20a%20draft%20Original%0A%20%20%20%20Investigation.%20It%20records%20the%20scientific%20rationale%20before%20the%20corresponding%20code%2C%20executes%20the%0A%20%20%20%20prespecified%20estimator%2C%20reports%20the%20analytic%20denominator%2C%20displays%20diagnostics%2C%20and%20states%20the%0A%20%20%20%20interpretation%20boundary.%20A%20statistician%20should%20be%20able%20to%20reconstruct%20each%20analysis%20without%0A%20%20%20%20consulting%20undocumented%20helper%20code.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Each%20**Statistical%20Analysis%20Module**%20governs%20the%20executable%20cells%20that%20follow%20it%20until%20the%20next%0A%20%20%20%20module.%20Every%20module%20states%2010%20items%3A%20scientific%20question%2C%20estimand%2C%20population%20and%20unit%2C%0A%20%20%20%20variables%20and%20denominator%2C%20mathematical%20definition%2C%20estimator%20and%20uncertainty%2C%20assumptions%20and%0A%20%20%20%20diagnostics%2C%20missingness%20and%20suppression%2C%20sensitivity%20analyses%2C%20and%20interpretation%20with%0A%20%20%20%20references.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%60results_authorized%3Dfalse%60%20is%20binding.%20Numerical%20model%20and%20geographic%20outputs%20are%20shown%20in%20this%0A%20%20%20%20statistician-review%20notebook%2C%20including%20its%20provisional%20JAMA-style%20summary.%20They%20must%20not%20be%0A%20%20%20%20copied%20into%20a%20submission%20manuscript%2C%20final%20figure%20legend%2C%20or%20coauthor%20material%20until%20the%0A%20%20%20%20independent%20reviewer%20approves%20the%20decisions%20listed%20below%20and%20S7%20review%20is%20signed.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Notebook%20order%20and%20review%20workflow%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20**Paper%20front%20matter%3A**%20study%20question%2C%20source%20roles%2C%20Key%20Points%2C%20structured%20abstract%2C%20and%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20publication%20claim.%0A%20%20%20%202.%20**Executable%20SAP%3A**%20governed%20data%20assembly%20followed%20by%20Statistical%20Analysis%20Modules%201%20through%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%206.%20Each%20module%20precedes%20the%20code%20that%20implements%20it.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20**Results%20in%20display%20order%3A**%20Table%201%2C%20Figure%201%2C%20and%20Table%202%2C%20followed%20by%20supplementary%20review%20figures.%20Every%20display%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20is%20followed%20by%20a%20biostatistical%20interpretation%20and%20an%20explicit%20limitation.%0A%20%20%20%204.%20**Supplementary%20analyses%3A**%20diagnostic%2C%20robustness%2C%20outcome-model%2C%20spatial%2C%20and%20unrun-analysis%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20records.%20These%20cannot%20replace%20the%20primary%20geographic%20evidence.%0A%20%20%20%205.%20**Discussion%20and%20references%3A**%20bounded%20scientific%20interpretation%2C%20public-health%20relevance%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20limitations%2C%20verified%20numbered%20citations%2C%20and%20reporting%20guidance.%0A%20%20%20%206.%20**Reproducibility%20and%20authorization%3A**%20artifact%20gallery%2C%20checksums%2C%20deterministic%20manifest%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20and%20the%20closed%20manuscript-export%20gate.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20order%20is%20deliberate.%20The%20notebook%20states%20each%20decision%20before%20displaying%20its%20result%2C%20keeps%0A%20%20%20%20CHM-only%20and%20cross-source%20populations%20separate%2C%20and%20places%20exploratory%20analyses%20after%20the%0A%20%20%20%20primary%20estimands.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Scientific%20question%2C%20design%2C%20and%20evidence%20hierarchy%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20primary%20study%20question%20is%20whether%20tract-level%20EHR-diagnosed%20proportions%20add%20geographic%0A%20%20%20%20information%20beyond%20the%20coarser%20labels%20assigned%20by%20Chicago%20community%20areas.%20A%20parallel%20ZCTA%0A%20%20%20%20analysis%20tests%20whether%20that%20conclusion%20depends%20on%20the%20second%20commonly%20used%20coarse%20geography.%0A%20%20%20%20CHM-PLACES%20alignment%20and%20community-area%20life-expectancy%20models%20provide%20secondary%20context.%20The%0A%20%20%20%20design%20is%20ecological%2C%20repeated-period%2C%20and%20cross-source.%20It%20supports%20description%20and%0A%20%20%20%20association%2C%20not%20causal%20effects.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20tract-resolution%20analyses%20A1%20through%20A7%20are%20a%20proposed%20primary-aim%20amendment%20recorded%20in%0A%20%20%20%20the%20implementation%20addendum.%20They%20remain%20a%20proposed%20methods%20amendment%20until%20the%20statistician%20and%20authors%0A%20%20%20%20sign%20the%20amendment%20and%20S7%20review%20is%20complete.%20Operational%20source%20checks%20are%20quality%20control%0A%20%20%20%20only.%20No%20public%20source%20is%20a%20validation%20standard%20or%20gold%20standard.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Analysis%20hierarchy%20and%20review%20status%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Family%20%7C%20Unit%20and%20population%20%7C%20Estimand%20or%20purpose%20%7C%20Current%20status%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C---%7C---%7C---%7C---%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Resource%20audit%20%7C%20geography-condition-year%20records%20%7C%20availability%2C%20suppression%2C%20missingness%2C%20capture%20%7C%20descriptive%20QC%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Within-community%20tract%20variation%20%7C%20CHM-complete%202022-2024%20tracts%20with%20dominant%20links%20%7C%20observed%20within-area%20variance%20share%20%7C%20proposed%20primary%20A1%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Direct%20tract%20vs%20community-area%20labels%20%7C%20CHM-complete%202022-2024%20tracts%20with%20dominant%20links%20%7C%20absolute%20rank%20gap%2C%20exact%20quartile%20disagreement%2C%20Q4%20movement%20%7C%20proposed%20primary%20A6%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Direct%20tract%20vs%20ZCTA%20labels%20%7C%20complete%202022-2024%20tracts%20with%20dominant%20ZCTA%20links%20%7C%20same%20classification%20metrics%20under%20a%20second%20coarse%20geography%20%7C%20sensitivity%20A6%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20CHM-PLACES%20alignment%20%7C%20pairwise-complete%20eligible%20tracts%20%7C%20rank%20alignment%20and%20ordinal%20agreement%20%7C%20secondary%20A3-A5%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Area-label%20separation%20%7C%20CHM-complete%20tracts%20in%20areas%20with%20at%20least%202%20tracts%20%7C%20leave-one-tract-out%20AUC%20%7C%20exploratory%20A2%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Local%20spatial%20structure%20%7C%20eligible%20community%20areas%20with%20complete%20topology%20%7C%20local%20Moran%20I%2C%20bivariate%20local%20Moran%20I%2C%20and%20Getis-Ord%20Gi*%20%7C%20supplementary%20A7%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20C1%2FC2%20outcome%20models%20%7C%20eligible%20community%20areas%20%7C%20ecological%20life-expectancy%20contrasts%20%7C%20supplementary%20demonstration%2C%20unauthorized%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Complementary%20source-role%20framework%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20publication%20claim%20concerns%20complementary%20evidence%20roles%2C%20not%20competition%20between%20maps.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Evidence%20source%20%7C%20Strongest%20supported%20role%20in%20this%20study%20%7C%20Boundary%20that%20must%20remain%20visible%20%7C%20Appropriate%20combined%20use%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C---%7C---%7C---%7C---%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Population-based%20public%20health%20data%20%7C%20estimate%20and%20compare%20health%20across%20defined%20populations%20%7C%20source-specific%20survey%2C%20modeling%2C%20period%2C%20and%20geography%20assumptions%20%7C%20retain%20as%20the%20basis%20for%20population%20inference%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Multi-institution%20health-system%20EHR%20data%20%7C%20describe%20clinically%20recorded%20diagnoses%20among%20observed%20adults%20at%20tract%20scale%20%7C%20care%20contact%2C%20system%20capture%2C%20coding%2C%20geocoding%2C%20suppression%2C%20and%20denominator%20selection%20%7C%20examine%20within-area%20clinical%20variation%20and%20generate%20follow-up%20questions%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Both%20sources%20together%20%7C%20assess%20whether%20geographic%20patterns%20align%20or%20diverge%20across%20measurement%20systems%20%7C%20neither%20source%20validates%20the%20other%20%7C%20triangulate%20signals%20and%20identify%20questions%20for%20additional%20public%20health%20assessment%20%7C%0A%0A%20%20%20%20A%20divergence%20is%20a%20measurement%20finding%2C%20not%20evidence%20that%20one%20source%20is%20wrong.%20A%20tract%20signal%0A%20%20%20%20may%20support%20additional%20investigation.%20It%20does%20not%20establish%20community%20prevalence%2C%20unmet%20need%2C%0A%20%20%20%20service%20location%2C%20or%20intervention%20benefit.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Editorial%20readiness%20gate%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Item%20%7C%20Current%20state%20%7C%20Required%20before%20submission%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C---%7C---%7C---%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Title%20and%20Key%20Points%20%7C%20nondeclarative%20title%20and%20primary%20geographic%20results%20only%20%7C%20confirm%20after%20S7%20review%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Primary%20uncertainty%20%7C%20community-area%20cluster%20intervals%20shown%20for%20review%20%7C%20approve%20the%20cluster%20unit%2C%20replicate%20count%2C%20and%20percentile%20interval%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Reference%20count%20%7C%2025%20verified%20references%20%7C%20reach%20the%20journal's%2050%20to%2075%20range%20with%20relevant%20verified%20sources%2C%20without%20padding%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Ethics%20and%20sharing%20%7C%20author%20placeholders%20remain%20%7C%20insert%20the%20exact%20IRB%2C%20consent%20or%20waiver%2C%20and%20data-sharing%20language%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20AI-assisted%20preparation%20%7C%20project%20ledger%20exists%20%7C%20complete%20the%20journal-required%20acknowledgment%20and%20human%20verification%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Results%20authorization%20%7C%20%60results_authorized%3Dfalse%60%20%7C%20complete%20the%20primary-aim%20amendment%20and%20independent%20S7%20review%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Controlling%20statistical%20decision%20registry%20for%20independent%20sign-off%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20table%20supersedes%20earlier%20exploratory%20notes.%20%E2%80%9CPrimary%E2%80%9D%20identifies%20evidence%20intended%20to%0A%20%20%20%20answer%20the%20paper's%20geographic-resolution%20question.%20%E2%80%9CSupplementary%E2%80%9D%20means%20the%20result%20may%20explain%0A%20%20%20%20the%20data%20source%20but%20cannot%20carry%20the%20main%20claim.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20ID%20%7C%20Decision%20%7C%20Review%20disposition%20and%20scientific%20reason%20%7C%20Required%20statistician%20action%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C---%7C---%7C---%7C---%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D1%20%7C%20Pooled%20CHM%20measure%20%7C%20**Keep.**%20Sum%20eligible%20annual%20numerators%20and%20denominators%20before%20division.%20An%20unweighted%20mean%20changes%20the%20estimand%20when%20denominators%20differ.%20%7C%20Approve%20the%20pooled%20proportion%20and%20annual-mean%20sensitivity.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D2%20%7C%20Primary%20geographic%20evidence%20%7C%20**Change%20completed.**%20Use%20within-area%20variance%20share%2C%20absolute%20percentile-rank%20gap%2C%20exact%20quartile%20disagreement%2C%20and%20Q4%20movement.%20The%20primary%20comparator%20pools%20the%20other%20eligible%20tracts%20in%20the%20focal%20tract's%20community%20area.%20Source-published%20area%20values%20are%20a%20secondary%20sensitivity.%20%7C%20Approve%20the%204%20co-primary%20descriptive%20measures%20and%20claim%20language.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D3%20%7C%20Quartile%20boundaries%20%7C%20**Change%20completed.**%20Q1%20is%20rank%20at%20most%200.25%2C%20Q2%20is%20greater%20than%200.25%20through%200.50%2C%20Q3%20is%20greater%20than%200.50%20through%200.75%2C%20and%20Q4%20is%20greater%20than%200.75.%20One%20function%20now%20governs%20all%20analyses.%20%7C%20Confirm%20the%20boundary%20and%20average-tie%20rule.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D4%20%7C%20Analysis%20populations%20%7C%20**Change%20completed.**%20A1%20and%20A2%20use%20CHM-complete%20tracts.%20CHM-PLACES%20agreement%20uses%20a%20separate%20pairwise-complete%20frame.%20Missing%20PLACES%20data%20cannot%20exclude%20a%20tract%20from%20a%20CHM-only%20estimand.%20%7C%20Confirm%20frame%20separation%20and%20denominator%20reporting.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D5%20%7C%20Variance%20partition%20%7C%20**Keep.**%20Use%20an%20observed-scale%20one-way%20method-of-moments%20estimator.%20Report%20the%20within-area%20complement.%20Mixed-model%20REML%20is%20a%20sensitivity%20only%20because%20the%20primary%20estimand%20is%20a%20descriptive%20partition%20of%20tract%20estimates.%3Csup%3E10%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%20Approve%20the%20estimator%20and%20whether%20a%20REML%20sensitivity%20is%20required.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D6%20%7C%20Cluster%20bootstrap%20%7C%20**Change%20completed.**%20Resample%20community%20areas%2C%20retain%20their%20tracts%2C%20recompute%20ranks%20and%20rank%20categories%20within%20every%20replicate%2C%20and%20use%20the%202.5th%20and%2097.5th%20percentiles.%3Csup%3E12%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%20Approve%201000%20replicates%20for%20review%20and%20whether%20the%20final%20run%20should%20use%205000.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D7%20%7C%20Area-label%20AUC%20%7C%20**Narrow.**%20Retain%20only%20as%20an%20exploratory%20separation%20statistic.%20Recompute%20the%20empirical%20Q4%20threshold%20in%20every%20cluster%20replicate.%20It%20is%20not%20prediction%20or%20external%20validation.%3Csup%3E11%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%20Approve%20exploratory%20retention%20or%20remove%20it.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D8%20%7C%20Ordinal%20agreement%20%7C%20**Narrow.**%20Exact%20agreement%20and%20quadratic%20weighted%20kappa%20are%20the%20ordinal%20summaries.%20Unweighted%20Gwet%20AC1%20remains%20a%20supplementary%20nominal%20sensitivity%20and%20is%20not%20co-primary.%3Csup%3E8%2C9%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%20Approve%20AC1%20retention%20or%20request%20weighted%20AC2.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D9%20%7C%20Capture%20and%20reliability%20%7C%20**Add%20to%20interpretation.**%20Report%20capture%20and%20source%20reliability%20strata%20without%20treating%20either%20as%20proof%20of%20representativeness.%20The%20source%20reliability%20algorithm%20remains%20a%20semantic%20sign-off%20item.%20%7C%20Approve%20the%20reliability%20rule%20and%20the%20primary%20sensitivity%20subset.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D10%20%7C%20HC3%20outcome%20models%20%7C%20**Change%20completed.**%20Keep%20C2%20supplementary%2C%20use%20the%20locked%20adjustment%20set%20and%20HC3%20covariance%2C%20and%20report%2095%25%20intervals%20with%20residual-degrees-of-freedom%20t%20critical%20values%20because%20the%20community-area%20sample%20is%20small.%3Csup%3E13%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%20Confirm%20the%20fixed%20t-based%20interval%20rule.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D11%20%7C%20Spatial%20analyses%20%7C%20**Narrow.**%20Global%20and%20local%20spatial%20statistics%20are%20supplementary.%20Queen%20weights%20are%20primary%2C%209999%20permutations%20are%20used%2C%20and%20false-discovery-rate%20families%20are%20declared%20before%20testing.%3Csup%3E14-17%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%20Approve%20topology%2C%20permutation%2C%20and%20multiplicity%20definitions.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D12%20%7C%20Combined%20diabetes%20%7C%20**Do%20not%20run.**%20Mutual%20exclusivity%2C%20denominator%20equivalence%2C%20phenotype%20mapping%2C%20and%20period%20alignment%20are%20unresolved.%20%7C%20Approve%20semantics%20or%20retain%20the%20blocker.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D13%20%7C%20ZCTA%20comparison%20%7C%20**Keep%20as%20sensitivity.**%20Use%20Census%20ZCTAs%20and%20do%20not%20describe%20them%20as%20USPS%20ZIP%20Codes.%20%7C%20Approve%20the%20secondary%20geography.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20D14%20%7C%20Life%20expectancy%20%7C%20**Keep%20as%20supplementary%20demonstration.**%20It%20illustrates%20one%20possible%20linked%20use%20at%20community-area%20scale%20and%20does%20not%20establish%20validity%2C%20causality%2C%20or%20tract-level%20benefit.%20%7C%20Approve%20retention%20outside%20the%20primary%20claim.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Manuscript%20display%20map%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20main%20paper%20uses%203%20displays%20in%20citation%20order%3A%20Table%201%20(CHM%20community-area%20coverage)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20Figure%201%20(geographic%20coverage%20and%20data%20quality)%2C%20and%20Table%202%20(compact%20cross-condition%20evidence).%0A%20%20%20%20The%20tract-alignment%20and%20finite-denominator%20review%20graphics%20are%20supplementary%20figures%20G1%20and%20G2.%0A%20%20%20%20The%20notebook%20renders%20Tables%201%20and%202%20as%20Great%20Tables%20HTML%20and%20exports%20editable%20CSV%20files.%20It%0A%20%20%20%20renders%20the%20main%20and%20supplementary%20figures%20as%20deterministic%20PDF%20and%20PNG%20files.%0A%20%20%20%20Model%20coefficients%2C%20residual%20diagnostics%2C%20and%20unrun%20analyses%20remain%20numbered%20supplementary%0A%20%20%20%20artifacts%20so%20the%20main%20narrative%20does%20not%20duplicate%20or%20overstate%20evidence.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo%2C%20review_summary)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(f%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Provisional%20JAMA%20Health%20Forum%20Original%20Investigation%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Provisional%20title%3A**%20Added%20Geographic%20Information%20From%20Tract-Level%20Health%20System%20Data%20in%20Chicago%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Article%20type%3A**%20Original%20Investigation.%20**Manuscript%20status%3A**%20author-facing%20scientific%0A%20%20%20%20notebook%20draft%3B%20%60results_authorized%3Dfalse%60%20and%20no%20empirical%20result%20may%20be%20imported%20into%20a%0A%20%20%20%20submission%20manuscript%20until%20independent%20S7%20review%20is%20complete.%20Tables%20and%20figures%20below%20are%0A%20%20%20%20rendered%20in%20citation%20order%20as%20editable%20Great%20Tables%20HTML%20and%20deterministic%20vector%2Fraster%20files.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Key%20Points%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Question%3A**%20Can%20tract-level%20health-system%20electronic%20health%20record%20(EHR)%20data%20add%20geographic%0A%20%20%20%20information%20beyond%20Chicago%20community-area%20labels%20while%20supplementing%20population-based%20public%0A%20%20%20%20health%20surveillance%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%20%7Breview_summary%5B%22primary_findings%22%5D%7D%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Meaning%3A**%20Health-system%20EHR%20data%20may%20supplement%20population-based%20surveillance%20by%20showing%0A%20%20%20%20within-area%20clinical%20variation%2C%20but%20they%20should%20not%20replace%20population%20estimates%20or%20directly%0A%20%20%20%20determine%20services.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20These%20findings%20are%20visible%20for%20independent%20biostatistical%20review.%20Manuscript%20import%20remains%0A%20%20%20%20closed%20while%20%60results_authorized%3Dfalse%60.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Structured%20Abstract%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Importance%0A%20%20%20%20Population-based%20public%20health%20data%20remain%20essential%20for%20community%20inference.%20Multi-institution%0A%20%20%20%20electronic%20health%20record%20(EHR)%20data%20may%20add%20a%20complementary%20clinical%20view%20at%20smaller%20geographic%0A%20%20%20%20scales%2C%20but%20selection%20into%20care%20and%20health-system%20capture%20limit%20population%20interpretation.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Objective%0A%20%20%20%20To%20determine%20whether%20direct%20Chicago%20Health%20Map%20tract%20measures%20retain%20geographic%20information%0A%20%20%20%20beyond%20direct%20community-area%20labels%20and%20to%20define%20their%20potential%20supplementary%20role%20alongside%0A%20%20%20%20public%20health%20data.%20ZIP%20Code%20Tabulation%20Area%20comparisons%20and%20cross-source%20comparisons%20were%0A%20%20%20%20secondary.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Design%0A%20%20%20%20Ecological%2C%20repeated-period%2C%20cross-source%20descriptive%20analysis%20of%202019%20through%202024%20records.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Setting%0A%20%20%20%20Chicago%2C%20Illinois.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Participants%0A%20%20%20%20Geography-condition-period%20records%20summarizing%20source-defined%20eligible%2C%20geocoded%20adults%0A%20%20%20%20observed%20in%20participating%20CAPriCORN%20systems.%20The%20analytic%20unit%20was%20a%20geographic%20record%2C%20not%20an%0A%20%20%20%20individual%20or%20encounter.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Exposures%0A%20%20%20%20Direct%20Chicago%20Health%20Map%20EHR-diagnosed%20proportions%20among%20observed%20CAPriCORN%20adults.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo%2C%20review_summary)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(f%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Main%20Outcomes%20and%20Measures%0A%20%20%20%20Exact%20tract%20and%20community-area%20quartile%20agreement%2C%20quartile%20disagreement%2C%20within-community%0A%20%20%20%20variance%20share%2C%20and%20movement%20into%20or%20out%20of%20the%20highest%20quartile.%20ZCTA%20comparisons%2C%20annual%0A%20%20%20%20stability%2C%20and%20rank%20alignment%20with%20the%20Centers%20for%20Disease%20Control%20and%20Prevention%20PLACES%20data%0A%20%20%20%20were%20secondary%20measures.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Results%0A%20%20%20%20%7Breview_summary%5B%22resource%22%5D%7D%20Patient-level%20demographic%20characteristics%20were%20not%20available%20in%0A%20%20%20%20the%20aggregate%20review%20extract.%20%7Breview_summary%5B%22primary_abstract%22%5D%7D%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Conclusions%20and%20Relevance%0A%20%20%20%20Direct%20community-area%20labels%20did%20not%20retain%20all%20tract%20heterogeneity%20and%20changed%20some%20tract%0A%20%20%20%20classifications.%20Health-system%20EHR%20data%20may%20supplement%20population-based%20surveillance%20when%20the%0A%20%20%20%20question%20concerns%20within-area%20clinical%20variation%20and%20capture%20limitations%20remain%20explicit.%0A%20%20%20%20These%20data%20should%20not%20replace%20population%20estimates%20or%20be%20used%20alone%20to%20infer%20community%20need%2C%0A%20%20%20%20direct%20services%2C%20or%20estimate%20causal%20effects.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Review%20status%3A**%20Aggregate%20results%20are%20shown%20for%20the%20independent%20statistician.%20They%20remain%0A%20%20%20%20ineligible%20for%20manuscript%20or%20coauthor%20import%20while%20%60results_authorized%3Dfalse%60.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Data%20Sharing%20Statement%0A%20%20%20%20%5BAUTHOR%3A%20state%20whether%2C%20how%2C%20and%20under%20what%20restrictions%20analytic%20code%2C%20derived%20data%2C%20and%0A%20%20%20%20governed%20source%20data%20may%20be%20accessed.%5D%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Acknowledgment%20and%20AI-Assisted%20Manuscript%20Preparation%0A%20%20%20%20%5BAUTHOR%3A%20complete%20the%20project%20AI-use%20disclosure%20with%20the%20platform%2C%20model%20and%20version%20or%0A%20%20%20%20%60unavailable%60%2C%20manufacturer%2C%20dates%20of%20use%2C%20manuscript%20sections%20affected%2C%20human%20verification%2C%0A%20%20%20%20and%20confirmation%20that%20the%20authors%20take%20responsibility%20for%20all%20content.%20The%20current%20record%20is%0A%20%20%20%20maintained%20in%20%60docs%2Fmanuscript%2Fai_disclosure_template.md%60.%5D%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%202.%20Methods%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Study%20design%20and%20data%20sources%0A%0A%20%20%20%20We%20conducted%20an%20ecological%2C%20repeated-period%2C%20cross-source%20analysis%20of%20direct%20CHM%20records%20from%0A%20%20%20%2077%20Chicago%20community%20areas%20and%20782%20census%20tracts%20whose%202024%20TIGER%20representative%20points%20were%0A%20%20%20%20covered%20by%20the%20frozen%20Chicago%20community-area%20union%2C%202019%20through%202024.%0A%20%20%20%20The%20primary%20geographic%20analyses%20pooled%20eligible%202022%20through%202024%20records.%20The%20analytic%20unit%0A%20%20%20%20was%20a%20geography-condition-period%20record%2C%20not%20a%20patient%20or%20encounter.%20The%20notebook%20builds%20and%0A%20%20%20%20validates%20one%20long-form%20analytic%20data%20set%20before%20analysis%2C%20then%20serializes%20displays%2C%20data%0A%20%20%20%20checks%2C%20and%20provenance%20artifacts%20from%20that%20same%20run.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Direct%20CHM%20disease%20values%20were%20never%20interpolated%2C%20replaced%20with%20public%20measures%2C%20or%20aggregated%0A%20%20%20%20from%20tract%20polygons.%20Public%20sources%20retained%20comparator%2C%20outcome-context%2C%20adjustment-context%2C%0A%20%20%20%20or%20geographic-linkage%20roles.%20This%20separation%20is%20important%3A%20a%20join%20can%20add%20context%20to%20a%20CHM%0A%20%20%20%20record%20without%20changing%20the%20clinical%20measure%20from%20which%20that%20record%20was%20derived.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20analysis%20treated%20the%202%20source%20classes%20as%20complementary.%20Public%20health%20sources%20retained%20the%0A%20%20%20%20population-surveillance%20role.%20CHM%20supplied%20a%20selected%20clinical%20ascertainment%20lens%20among%0A%20%20%20%20observed%20CAPriCORN%20adults.%20Joint%20analyses%20tested%20alignment%20or%20divergence%20between%20measurement%0A%20%20%20%20systems%20and%20did%20not%20validate%20either%20source.%20This%20source-role%20distinction%20was%20prespecified%20for%0A%20%20%20%20every%20estimand%20and%20display.%3Csup%3E1-5%2C7%3C%2Fsup%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Study%20population%2C%20geography%2C%20and%20measures%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Statistical%20Analysis%20Module%200%3A%20governed%20data%20assembly%20and%20sample%20flow%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20module%20governs%20the%20dataset-build%2C%20source-contract%2C%20and%20sample-flow%20cells%20that%20follow.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Review%20item%20%7C%20Prespecified%20rule%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C---%7C---%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Scientific%20question%20%7C%20Which%20governed%20aggregate%20records%20can%20support%20each%20analysis%20without%20changing%20the%20meaning%20of%20a%20source%20measure%3F%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Estimand%20%7C%20No%20disease%20estimand.%20This%20module%20counts%20available%2C%20excluded%2C%20suppressed%2C%20missing%2C%20and%20analytic%20geography-condition-period%20records.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Population%20and%20unit%20%7C%20Aggregate%20CHM%2C%20Census%2C%20PLACES%2C%20Chicago%20Health%20Atlas%2C%20and%20geographic-linkage%20records.%20No%20row%20represents%20a%20patient.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Variables%20and%20denominator%20%7C%20Source%20identifiers%2C%20geography%20and%20period%20keys%2C%20numerator%2C%20denominator%2C%20published%20value%2C%20suppression%20state%2C%20capture%2C%20reliability%20metadata%2C%20and%20linkage%20weights.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Mathematical%20definition%20%7C%20Every%20many-to-one%20or%20one-to-one%20join%20is%20validated%20at%20its%20declared%20key.%20Analytic%20counts%20are%20reconciled%20from%20source%20rows%20through%20exclusions%20to%20final%20frames.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Estimator%20and%20uncertainty%20%7C%20Counts%2C%20percentages%2C%20ranges%2C%20and%20missingness%20summaries%20only.%20No%20confidence%20interval%20is%20attached%20to%20data%20availability.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Assumptions%20and%20diagnostics%20%7C%20Geography%20vintage%2C%20period%2C%20unit%2C%20uniqueness%2C%20direct-measure%20derivation%2C%20and%20join%20cardinality%20must%20pass.%20Output%20checksums%20bind%20each%20result%20to%20its%20inputs.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Missingness%20and%20suppression%20%7C%20Suppressed%2C%20missing%2C%20unreliable%2C%20structural-zero%2C%20and%20observed-zero%20states%20remain%20distinct.%20Disease%20values%20are%20never%20imputed%20or%20reconstructed%20from%20neighboring%20geographies.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Sensitivities%20%7C%20Analysis-specific%20complete-case%20counts%20are%20shown%20because%20CHM-only%2C%20CHM-PLACES%2C%20spatial%2C%20and%20outcome-linked%20frames%20need%20different%20inputs.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Interpretation%20and%20references%20%7C%20Data%20availability%20describes%20the%20delivered%20aggregate%20resource.%20It%20does%20not%20validate%20person%20linkage%2C%20phenotype%20accuracy%2C%20representativeness%2C%20or%20population%20coverage.%3Csup%3E1-5%2C7%2C18%2C19%2C25%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20analytic%20dataset%20starts%20with%20direct%20CHM%2FCAPriCORN%20condition%20facts%20and%20adds%20public%20context%0A%20%20%20%20only%20through%20explicit%20keys.%20Clinical%20measures%2C%20adjustment%20covariates%2C%20outcomes%2C%20comparators%2C%0A%20%20%20%20and%20geographic%20metadata%20retain%20separate%20source%20roles.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20archived%20ChicagoHealthMap.com%20methods%20state%20that%207%20health%20systems%20contribute%20data%20through%0A%20%20%20%20the%20PCORnet%20Common%20Data%20Model%2C%20that%20an%20anonymized%20linkage%20process%20deduplicates%20people%20across%0A%20%20%20%20systems%2C%20and%20that%20the%20resource%20covers%20adults%20aged%2018%20years%20or%20older%20observed%20from%202019%20through%0A%20%20%20%202024%20across%206%20northeastern%20Illinois%20counties.%3Csup%3E25%3C%2Fsup%3E%20The%20site%20also%20documents%20a%20less-than-10%0A%20%20%20%20suppression%20rule%2C%20capture%20tiers%2C%202020%20census-tract%20geography%2C%20and%20ICD-10%20definitions%20for%2038%0A%20%20%20%20chronic%20conditions%20plus%20firearm%20injury.%20These%20statements%20define%20the%20intended%20resource.%20This%0A%20%20%20%20analysis%20audits%20the%20delivered%20aggregate%20extracts%20and%20does%20not%20independently%20validate%20the%0A%20%20%20%20website's%20person-linkage%2C%20phenotype%2C%20or%20coverage%20claims.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(%0A%20%20%20%20ensure_chicago_case_study_dataset%2C%0A%20%20%20%20json%2C%0A%20%20%20%20output_dir%2C%0A%20%20%20%20params%2C%0A%20%20%20%20project_root%2C%0A)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20dataset_build_decision%20%3D%20ensure_chicago_case_study_dataset(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20root%3Dproject_root%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20output_dir%3Doutput_dir%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20output_stem%3D%2200_master_analytic_dataset%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20rebuild%3Dparams.rebuild%2C%0A%20%20%20%20)%0A%20%20%20%20_join_path%20%3D%20dataset_build_decision.artifacts.source_join_manifest_path%0A%20 definition.%20Joint%20uncertainty-aware%20agreement%2C%20bivariate%20LISA%2C%20and%20spatial-scan%0A%20%20%20%20analyses%20are%20also%20labeled%20not%20run%20when%20their%20required%20inputs%20or%20specifications%20are%20absent.%0A%20%20%20%20A%20not-run%20analysis%20is%20not%20a%20null%20finding.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Direct%20ZCTA%20comparisons%20are%20secondary%20to%20community%20areas.%20Annual%20and%20noncrossing%20analyses%20test%0A%20%20%20%20stability%20of%20the%20descriptive%20classifications.%20They%20do%20not%20estimate%20time%20trends%20or%20causal%0A%20%20%20%20effects%20of%20geographic%20scale.%20Every%20comparison%20retains%20its%20condition-specific%20eligible%0A%20%20%20%20denominator%20and%20%60results_authorized%3Dfalse%60%20status.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Ethics%20and%20reporting%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20analysis%20dates%20were%20July%2013%20through%20July%2016%2C%202026.%20Software%20was%20Python%203.13.14%0A%20%20%20%20(Python%20Software%20Foundation)%2C%20marimo%200.23.14%2C%20pandas%203.0.3%2C%20NumPy%202.5.1%2C%20SciPy%201.18.0%2C%0A%20%20%20%20statsmodels%200.14.6%2C%20GeoPandas%201.1.4%2C%20Matplotlib%203.11.0%2C%20and%20Great%20Tables%200.22.0.%0A%20%20%20%20Reporting%20follows%20STROBE%20and%20RECORD%20principles%20for%20an%20ecological%20analysis%20of%20routinely%0A%20%20%20%20collected%20data.%3Csup%3E18%2C19%3C%2Fsup%3E%20Journal%20structure%20follows%20the%20JAMA%20Health%20Forum%20Original%0A%20%20%20%20Investigation%20instructions%20checked%20August%2027%2C%202026.%3Csup%3E20%3C%2Fsup%3E%20The%20study%20has%20a%20UIC%20IRB%0A%20%20%20%20record%20(protocol%20No.%20%5BUIC%20IRB%20PROTOCOL%20NUMBER%5D).%0A%20%20%20%20%5BAUTHOR%3A%20insert%20the%20exact%20ethics%20determination%20and%20informed-consent%20or%20waiver%20language%20before%0A%20%20%20%20submission.%5D%20Results%20remain%20nonimportable%20while%20%60results_authorized%3Dfalse%60.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Statistical%20Analysis%20Module%201%3A%20added%20geographic%20information%20beyond%20community-area%20labels%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20module%20governs%20the%20CHM-only%20tract%20frames%2C%20variance%20partition%2C%20direct%20cross-frame%20rank%20and%0A%20%20%20%20classification%20comparisons%2C%20and%20noncrossing%20sensitivity%20cells%20that%20follow.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Review%20item%20%7C%20Prespecified%20rule%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C---%7C---%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Scientific%20question%20%7C%20Do%20direct%20tract%20measures%20contain%20geographic%20information%20that%20direct%20community-area%20labels%20do%20not%20retain%3F%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Estimands%20%7C%20Within-community%20observed%20variance%20share%2C%20median%20and%20mean%20absolute%20tract-to-area%20percentile-rank%20gap%2C%20exact%20quartile%20disagreement%2C%20and%20movement%20into%20or%20out%20of%20Q4.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Population%20and%20unit%20%7C%20Census%20tracts%20passing%20the%202024%20TIGER%20representative-point%20Chicago%20boundary%20rule%20and%20CHM-complete%20in%202022-2024%2C%20with%20annual%20denominators%20of%20at%20least%2030%20and%20dominant%20community-area%20overlay%20weight%20at%20least%200.99.%20The%20unit%20is%20a%20tract.%20A1%20and%20A2%20do%20not%20require%20PLACES.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Variables%20and%20denominator%20%7C%20Direct%20pooled%20CHM%20numerator%20and%20denominator%2C%20direct%20tract%20and%20community-area%20ranks%2C%20community-area%20linkage%2C%20crossing%20status%2C%20capture%2C%20and%20reliability%20metadata.%20Every%20percentage%20reports%20the%20eligible%20tract%20count.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Mathematical%20definition%20%7C%20%24P_%7Bgc%7D%3D100%5Csum_t%20n_%7Bgct%7D%2F%5Csum_t%20d_%7Bgct%7D%24.%20Absolute%20rank%20gap%20is%20%24%7CR_%7Btract%7D-R_%7Barea%7D%7C%24.%20Q4%20is%20rank%20greater%20than%200.75.%20The%20within-area%20variance%20share%20is%20%241-VPC%24.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Estimator%20and%20uncertainty%20%7C%20One-way%20method-of-moments%20variance%20partition%20and%20direct%20cross-frame%20descriptive%20summaries.%20Community-area%20cluster%20percentile%20intervals%20use%201000%20review%20replicates.%3Csup%3E10%2C12%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Assumptions%20and%20diagnostics%20%7C%20Direct%20tract%20and%20community-area%20exports%20are%20sufficiently%20comparable%20for%20linked%20classification%2C%20dominant%20overlay%20identifies%20one%20area%2C%20and%20observed-scale%20variance%20is%20interpretable.%20Denominator%20distributions%2C%20tract%20counts%20per%20area%2C%20influence%20of%20crossing%20tracts%2C%20and%20bootstrap%20stability%20are%20reviewed.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Missingness%20and%20suppression%20%7C%20Require%203%20eligible%20CHM%20years.%20Exclude%20suppressed%20or%20invalid%20disease%20records%2C%20annual%20denominators%20below%2030%2C%20and%20unresolved%20zero-or-suppressed%20counts.%20Do%20not%20require%20a%20public%20comparator%20and%20do%20not%20impute%20any%20disease%20value.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Sensitivities%20%7C%20At%20least%2050%25%20tract%20area%20inside%20Chicago%2C%20noncrossing%20tracts%2C%20ZCTA%20labels%2C%20annual%20and%202-of-3%20stability%2C%20alternative%20tertiles%2C%20capture%20strata%2C%20reliability%20strata%2C%20and%20unweighted%20annual%20means.%20The%20unweighted%20mean%20is%20never%20substituted%20for%20the%20primary%20pooled%20estimator.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Interpretation%20and%20references%20%7C%20A%20difference%20shows%20that%20direct%20labels%20classify%20the%20same%20linked%20tract%20differently%20across%20source%20frames.%20It%20is%20not%20mathematical%20aggregation%20loss%2C%20population%20prevalence%2C%20a%20validated%20hotspot%2C%20or%20evidence%20of%20community%20need.%3Csup%3E1-5%2C18%2C19%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20primary%20paper%20claim%20must%20follow%20these%20estimands.%20Exploratory%20AUC%2C%20CHM-PLACES%20agreement%2C%0A%20%20%20%20spatial%20statistics%2C%20and%20life-expectancy%20models%20cannot%20substitute%20for%20them.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(pd%2C%20primary_frame%2C%20summarize_influence)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20c1_influence%20%3D%20pd.DataFrame(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%5B%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%7B%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22model_id%22%3A%20%22C1%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22row_type%22%3A%20%22model_summary%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22analysis_status%22%3A%20%22not_run_combined_diabetes_semantics_unapproved%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22results_authorized%22%3A%20False%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%7D%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%5D%0A%20%20%20%20)%0A%20%20%20%20c2_areas%2C%20c2_influence_summary%20%3D%20summarize_influence(primary_frame%2C%20%22C2%22)%0A%20%20%20%20c2_influence%20%3D%20pd.concat(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%5Bc2_areas.assign(row_type%3D%22area%22)%2C%20c2_influence_summary.assign(row_type%3D%22model_summary%22)%5D%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20ignore_index%3DTrue%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20sort%3DFalse%2C%0A%20%20%20%20)%0A%20%20%20%20return%20c1_influence%2C%20c2_influence%2C%20c2_influence_summary%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(c1_influence%2C%20c2_influence%2C%20output_dir)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20c1_influence.to_csv(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20output_dir%20%2F%20%22supplement_influence_c1.csv%22%2C%20index%3DFalse%2C%20float_format%3D%22%25.12g%22%0A%20%20%20%20)%0A%20%20%20%20c2_influence.to_csv(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20output_dir%20%2F%20%22supplement_influence_c2.csv%22%2C%20index%3DFalse%2C%20float_format%3D%22%25.12g%22%0A%20%20%20%20)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(%0A%20%20%20%20analytic%2C%0A%20%20%20%20build_direct_tract_analysis_frame%2C%0A%20%20%20% 0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Estimands%20%7C%20Spearman%20rank%20correlation%2C%20median%20absolute%20percentile-rank%20gap%2C%20exact%20quartile%20agreement%2C%20quadratic%20weighted%20kappa%2C%20and%20supplementary%20unweighted%20Gwet%20AC1.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Population%20and%20unit%20%7C%20Tracts%20with%203%20eligible%20CHM%20years%2C%20a%20compatible%20PLACES%20estimate%2C%20and%20dominant%20community-area%20linkage.%20The%20unit%20is%20a%20pairwise-complete%20tract.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Variables%20and%20denominator%20%7C%20Pooled%20CHM%20diagnosed%20proportion%2C%20PLACES%20modeled%20crude%20percentage%2C%20within-source%20average-tie%20percentile%20ranks%2C%20capture%20quartile%2C%20and%20source%20reliability%20tier.%20Each%20condition%20has%20its%20own%20paired%20denominator.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Mathematical%20definition%20%7C%20%24%5Crho_s%3Dcor(rank(CHM)%2Crank(PLACES))%24.%20Rank%20gap%20is%20%24%7CR_%7BCHM%7D-R_%7BPLACES%7D%7C%24.%20Quadratic%20kappa%20weights%20category%20distance%20by%20%24%5B(a-b)%2F3%5D%5E2%24.%3Csup%3E8%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Estimator%20and%20uncertainty%20%7C%20Descriptive%20coefficients%20with%20community-area%20cluster%20percentile%20intervals.%20Ranks%20and%20rank-derived%20categories%20are%20recomputed%20within%20every%20resample.%3Csup%3E8%2C9%2C12%3C%2Fsup%3E%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Assumptions%20and%20diagnostics%20%7C%20Sources%20have%20compatible%20condition%20direction%2C%20adult%20scope%2C%20geography%20vintage%2C%20and%20interpretable%20period%20overlap.%20Marginal%20category%20distributions%20and%20eligible%20counts%20are%20shown%20with%20agreement%20statistics.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Missingness%20and%20suppression%20%7C%20Pairwise%20complete.%20A%20missing%20PLACES%20value%20excludes%20only%20this%20module.%20Suppressed%20CHM%20records%20are%20not%20imputed.%20A5%20propagates%20PLACES%20intervals%20only%20because%20compatible%20CHM%20uncertainty%20is%20unavailable.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20% %5B'quartile_disagree_pct'%5D%3A.1f%7D%25)%20and%20%7B_c%5B'quartile_disagree_count'%5D%3A.0f%7D%20of%20%7Bint(_c%5B'resolution_eligible_n'%5D)%7D%20COPD%20tracts%20(%7B_c%5B'quartile_disagree_pct'%5D%3A.1f%7D%25).%20Within-community%20variation%20accounted%20for%20%7B_h%5B'within_variance_share'%5D%3A.3f%7D%20of%20observed%20tract%20variation%20in%20hypertension%20and%20%7B_c%5B'within_variance_share'%5D%3A.3f%7D%20in%20COPD.%20In%20the%20secondary%20cross-source%20analysis%2C%20Spearman%20rho%20was%20%7B_h%5B'spearman_r'%5D%3A.3f%7D%20for%20hypertension%20and%20%7B_c%5B'spearman_r'%5D%3A.3f%7D%20for%20COPD.%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22classification%22%3A%20f%22Community-area%20labels%20moved%20%7B_h%5B'q4_movers_n'%5D%3A.0f%7D%20hypertension%20tracts%20and%20%7B_c%5B'q4_movers_n'%5D%3A.0f%7D%20COPD%20tracts%20into%20or%20out%20of%20Q4.%20Annual%20Q4%20Jaccard%20overlap%20ranged%20from%20%7B100*_annual.loc%5B'hypertension'%2C'min'%5D%3A.1f%7D%25%20to%20%7B100*_annual.loc%5B'hypertension'%2C'max'%5D%3A.1f%7D%25%20for%20hypertension%20and%20%7B100*_annual.loc%5B'copd'%2C'min'%5D%3A.1f%7D%25%20to%20%7B100*_annual.loc%5B'copd'%2C'max'%5D%3A.1f%7D%25%20for%20COPD.%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22primary_findings%22%3A%20f%22In%20this%20ecological%20repeated-period%20analysis%2C%20tract%20and%20community-area%20quartiles%20disagreed%20for%20%7B_h%5B'quartile_disagree_count'%5D%3A.0f%7D%20of%20%7Bint(_h%5B'resolution_eligible_n'%5D)%7D%20hypertension%20tracts%20(%7B_h%5B'quartile_disagree_pct'%5D%3A.1f%7D%25)%20and%20%7B_c%5B'quartile_disagree_count'%5D%3A.0f%7D%20of%20%7Bint(_c%5B'resolution_eligible_n'%5D)%7D%20COPD%20tracts%20(%7B_c%5B'quartile_disagree_pct'%5D%3A.1f%7D%25).%20The%20community-area%20labels%20moved%20%7B_h%5B'q4_movers_n'%5D%3A.0f%7D%20and%20%7B_c%5B'q4_movers_n'%5D%3A.0f%7D%20tracts%2C%20respectively%2C%20into%20or%20out%20of%20the%20highest%20quartile.%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22primary_abstract%22%3A%20f%22Direct%20tract%20and%20li %20remain%20the%20basis%20for%20estimating%20community%20health.%20CHM%20adds%20a%20selected%0A%20%20%20%20clinical%20lens%20that%20can%20reveal%20variation%20in%20recorded%20diagnoses%20within%20the%20boundaries%20used%20for%0A%20%20%20%20public%20reporting.%20The%20results%20support%20complementarity%20rather%20than%20interchangeability.%20Used%0A%20%20%20%20together%2C%20the%20sources%20can%20show%20where%20geographic%20patterns%20align%20and%0A%20%20%20%20where%20an%20apparent%20difference%20warrants%20additional%20measurement%20or%20community%20assessment.%20A%0A%20%20%20%20difference%20does%20not%20identify%20which%20source%20is%20correct.%3Csup%3E1-5%2C7%3C%2Fsup%3E%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20division%20of%20roles%20is%20the%20paper's%20policy%20relevance.%20Health-system%20data%20can%20help%20test%0A%20%20%20%20whether%20a%20coarse%20label%20conceals%20local%20clinical%20variation%2C%20monitor%20source-specific%20patterns%20over%0A%20%20%20%20repeated%20periods%2C%20and%20generate%20questions%20for%20public%20health%20partners.%20Population-based%20sources%0A%20%20%20%20remain%20necessary%20for%20population%20inference%2C%20calibration%2C%20and%20comparison%20across%20communities.%0A%20%20%20%20Neither%20source%20alone%20establishes%20unmet%20need%2C%20service%20location%2C%20or%20intervention%20benefit.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Limitations%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Selection%20into%20CAPriCORN%20limits%20generalizability%20to%20all%20Chicago%20residents.%20CHM%20measures%20reflect%0A%20%20%20%20clinical%20contact%2C%20diagnosis%2C%20coding%2C%20address%20quality%2C%20and%20participating-system%20coverage.%20The%0A%20%20%20%20analysis%20could%20not%20independently%20verify%20the%20website's%20cross-system%20deduplication%20or%20phenotype%0A%20%20%20%20claims.%20CHM%20and%20PLACES%20use%20different%20source%20populations%2C%20constructs%2C%20and%20periods.%20
